title: Beta feedback from 12 Westbrook students
text:
Hi Wop,

I sat down with 12 of our Westbrook beta testers this week. Here's a summary of what they said.

What they liked:
- Getting matched with people from the same course section, not just the same course
- The weekly free-time grid. Several people said it was faster than texting a group chat.
- The reminder 30 minutes before a session (when it works, see below)

What they didn't like:
- The "about you" screen in onboarding felt too long, and 4 people almost quit there
- 5 testers on Android 15 never got any notifications
- There's no way to leave a group without messaging everyone

Biggest request: a way to book a library study room right from the app.

I'll send more notes after I talk to the engineering study groups on Monday.

Tomás Rivera
Campus Ambassador, Westbrook University
